n5270114c4a.headline: Vodafone buys the largest Czech cable network UPC and other Liberty Global activities | Aktuálně.cz
n5270114c4a.summary: Vodafone completed a transaction valued at 471 billion Czech crowns to buy the largest Czech cable network UPC and other Liberty Global activities. This is one of Vodafone's largest acquisitions.
n5270114c4a.why: Vodafone is the world's second-largest mobile operator, and this acquisition expands its fixed-line and cable network presence in the Czech Republic, impacting telecom market competition and infrastructure.

nc244dae572.headline: Vanilla is now more expensive than silver. Cyclone in Madagascar damaged plantations | Aktuálně.cz
nc244dae572.summary: Vanilla prices have risen sharply to around 13,000 CZK per kilogram following cyclone damage to plantations in Madagascar, a major vanilla producer.
nc244dae572.why: Madagascar is the world's largest vanilla producer; supply disruptions cause price spikes affecting food, beverage, and fragrance industries globally.
